# Weekly Meal Planner

> Plan your family's weekly meals with ease. Browse recipe suggestions, save favorites, build a shopping list, and organize breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the whole week.

Plan your family's meals for the entire week with ease. Weekly Meal Planner helps you organize breakfast, lunch, and dinner across all seven days of the week, so you always know what's cooking.

The public planner is the logged-out home page. Saving a meal plan and favorites requires an account. Auth and payment URLs are not content pages.

## Plan Your Week

Click on any day and meal type to add a meal. Each meal can include a name, description, list of ingredients, cooking instructions, and a time slot. Switch between breakfast, lunch, and dinner to plan every meal of the day.

## Recipe Suggestions

Browse a curated library of meal suggestions and recipes from around the web. Save your favorites and add them directly to your weekly menu with a single click.

## Save Your Favorites

Build a personal collection of favorite meals. Sign in to save your meal plan and favorites to your account, so they are available on any device.

## Ingredients and Shopping

View all ingredients for your planned meals in one place, making it easy to build your shopping list for the week.

## Pages

- [Weekly Meal Planner](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/): Plan your family's meals for the entire week with ease. Weekly Meal Planner helps you organize breakfast, lunch, and dinner across all seven days of the week, so you always know what's cooking.
- [Cheap Weekly Meal Plan: Budget-Friendly Ideas](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/cheap-weekly-meal-plan): Plan a budget-friendly week of meals: six simple steps, a sample 7-day plan and shopping habits that help you waste less food.
- [Weekly Meal Plan for a Family of 4 | Sample Week](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/family-of-4-meal-plan): A weekly meal plan for a family of four: a sample week of breakfasts, lunches and dinners, packed lunch ideas and a planning checklist.
- [Meal Prep Shopping List: How to Write One + Template](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/meal-prep-shopping-list): Turn your weekly meal plan into a meal prep shopping list. Five steps, a list grouped by shop section and a template you can copy.
- [7-Day Dinner Plan: Sample Week and Dinner Themes](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/7-day-dinner-plan): Build a 7-day dinner plan in six steps. Includes nightly dinner themes, a sample week, quick weeknight ideas and a checklist.
- [Weekly Breakfast Plan: Quick and Make-Ahead Ideas](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/weekly-breakfast-ideas): Plan a week of breakfasts: a sample weekly plan, quick weekday ideas, make-ahead breakfasts and weekend favourites.
- [Printable Weekly Meal Planner Layout + Example Week](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/printable-weekly-meal-planner): A printable weekly meal planner layout with breakfast, lunch, dinner, notes and a shopping list section, plus a filled-in example.
- [Sitemap](https://www.weeklymealplan.space/sitemap.xml): Public prerendered pages.
